tool_args.rationale: The wide-s_grad probe resolves the initial vmax/rho collinearity, and all seven rows are consistent with the three-parameter siphon base plus a positive square-root local branch. Fit those parameters numerically over the specified wide fallback bounds; no additional paid observation is warranted.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire another open-branch or fine-trajectory probe
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid open-branch probe already extends s_grad from the narrow pilot span to 0.18–2.35, resolving the relevant rho leverage; the seven observations support fitting the three-parameter base.

considered_alternatives.option: Negative square-root branch or mass-drift leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed output increases with u_now and the authorized monotone-concave completion slot is the square-root branch; the fitted coefficient can take either sign if data require it.
The observed maximum s_grad is 2.35, below the stated supercritical threshold-probe regime (>2.36); no avalanche evidence supports adding two parameters.
Its high-u decline conflicts with the observed monotone increase across the pilot u_now range.
